title: Two giant pandas, emblems of China soft diplomacy, arrive in US
summary: Two giant pandas sent by China arrived in the United States on Sunday, Beijing and the Atlanta zoo said, after a leaders' summit that was heavy on symbolism and light on major breakthroughs.
